headline: Millions Mourn Khamenei as Israel Strikes Iranian Proxies Across Three Fronts
subheadline: IDF eliminates two Hamas commanders in Gaza while Chief of Staff demands Lebanese Army clear Hezbollah from Beaufort Ridge as Iraqi armor deploys to Erbil
lede: Millions gathered in Tehran's Imam Hussein Square for Supreme Leader Khamenei's historic funeral procession. Simultaneously, Israeli forces struck a Hezbollah cell on motorcycles in al-Aqida near Nabatieh and eliminated two Hamas commanders in Gaza, including Nukhba platoon commander Mohammed Najib Ashor. At Beaufort Ridge, the IDF Chief of Staff declared the area full of terror infrastructure and warned the Lebanese Army must clear Hezbollah or face renewed Israeli attacks. Iraqi Popular Mobilization Forces deployed armored vehicles and helicopters to Garda Rash village in Erbil, signaling potential confrontation as regional tensions escalate.

sections.title: Massive Russian Barrage Hits Kyiv, Crimea Struck
sections.body: Russian forces launched over 20 missiles and numerous Shahed drones targeting Kyiv and multiple regions, with missile groups launched from Chernihiv and Poltava toward Brovary and Boryspil. Ukrainian air defenses engaged Shahed drones over northern Kyiv districts and cruise missiles over Chernihiv region. A Russian strike on a gas station in Izium, Kharkiv region, killed one man and caused fires. Meanwhile, Ukrainian strikes on two major power substations in occupied Crimea left Saki, Yevpatoria, and parts of Bakhchisarai district without power.

sections.title: Khamenei Funeral, IDF Strikes, Iraqi Mobilization
sections.body: Millions of mourners attended the historic funeral procession for Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei at Tehran's Imam Hussein Square. The IDF struck a Hezbollah cell on motorcycles in al-Aqida near Nabatieh, southern Lebanon, and eliminated two Hamas commanders in Gaza: Nukhba platoon commander Mohammed Najib Ashor and squad leader Tamir Said Abu Nahal. At Beaufort Ridge, the IDF Chief of Staff demanded the Lebanese Army implement agreements to clear Hezbollah or face renewed Israeli attacks. Iraqi Popular Mobilization Forces deployed armored vehicles with helicopters to Garda Rash village in Erbil for a reported confrontation.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous occurrence of Khamenei's massive funeral in Tehran and continued Israeli kinetic operations against Iranian proxies in Lebanon and Gaza creates a volatile escalation window. Israel's explicit warning at Beaufort Ridge signals low tolerance for proxy reconstitution, while Iraqi militia mobilization in Erbil suggests Iranian-backed forces are preparing for potential confrontation. Reuters reports Gulf states remain unwilling to fund Iranian reconstruction despite U.S. pressure, highlighting Tehran's economic isolation.
